_what_this_is: The first attempt to reach real GPU science. Stages B and C passed, stage D ran the full depth.causal_kl_greedy_v1 search -- 7 rounds, 260 evaluations, 28 minutes -- and then the FROZEN PARENT GATE refused the result. That is the gate doing its job: it stopped the session before any recovery training, which is what section 5 requires of a replay that does not reproduce the frozen identity.
_root_cause: NOT a hardware qualification failure: the GPU and the runtime were both the ones that originally produced the frozen parent. The driver called materialize_fixed_path WITHOUT the execution config the plan pins (micro_batch_size: 1), so DEPTH ran at the repository default. L40S GEMMs reduce shape-dependently, so the micro-batch changes which layer a near-tie selects -- round 7 chose layer 21 over 17 by a margin of 1.403e-03. The plan pins the value for exactly this reason and says so.
_therefore: An ordinary pre-treatment engineering defect, repaired under P12.1: the driver now applies the pinned config and refuses a plan that pins none. No recovery training began, so no measurement was retried, resumed or pooled.
